confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live listings, booking pages, or menus were inspected. Beer and restaurant anchors are relatively better grounded. Accommodation is least certain because Zona Sul beachfront rates differ sharply from Centro and Lapa, and July school holidays can lift prices. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer price relationship (roughly 2 to 2.5 times beer), not specific venues. The FX value comes from rba.gov.au search-result summaries rather than a direct page read. A 15 Oct figure mentioned in those summaries post-dates the generation date and was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Brazilian major tourism cities with similar mid-range pricing, including São Paulo and coastal destinations such as Salvador and Florianópolis, with a Zona Sul beachfront premium applied to hotel and restaurant anchors. No single comparable city was copied. USD values reflect general-knowledge local price levels converted at an approximate exchange rate, not a live quote.
